gaps.sentence: The ___ (APPLY) for the visa took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'The application' = the act or form of applying; 'applicant' = the person.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
We've received your ___ (REQUEST) for a refund.

gaps.explanation: 'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.
